ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a schematic diagram of an insect life cycle, with an arrow cycle. A is labeled beside a winged adult insect, D is labeled beside a group of small objects like eggs, B is labeled beside a light-colored, wingless, worm-shaped larva, and C is labeled beside a dark-colored, oval pupal stage. Then reason: the question asks what stage corresponds to "the form of many insects just after hatching, wingless, often worm-shaped, and before metamorphosis." The appearance of B in the image matches this description; according to the life cycle of complete metamorphosis in insects, after an egg hatches it enters the larva stage, then becomes a pupa, and then becomes an adult. Therefore the answer is larva.
